adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new public GET route `get 'embed/best' => 'embed#best'` and controller action `EmbedController#best` which, when no existing `TopicEmbed` is found, enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` for a caller-supplied `embed_url` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The only gate shown is `ensure_embeddable`, which checks `request.referer` host against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`—a header that is trivially forgeable by non-browser clients—and does not constrain `params[:embed_url]` beyond being present. The enqueued job executes `TopicRetriever#retrieve`, and for each novel URL on the allowed host it can run expensive work: `perform_retrieve` will call `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `feed_polling_enabled` is true, plus `fetch_http` which ultimately does `open(url).read` and Readability parsing (lib/topic_retriever.rb, app/models/topic_embed.rb). The throttling is per-URL (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), so an attacker can bypass it by varying the URL path/query to trigger repeated expensive processing. This is a verifiable DoS amplification risk introduced by the new embedding flow.
